cases.rubric: The laptop belongs to a colleague; the owner has not ordered one. Preserve both clauses without moving the denial to the colleague.

batches.text: A colleague bought a new laptop. I have not ordered one and still use my old desktop.

cases.rubric: Quoted relocation belongs to Rina; the account owner remains in their original apartment. The full quotation context must stay available.

batches.text: Rina told me, 'I moved to a new apartment last week.' I am still in my original apartment and have no moving plans.
